description: This file defines API routes for authentication in a FastAPI application, including registration, login, token refresh, and logout functionalities. It interacts with an AuthService for user management and manages authentication tokens via cookies.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: TokenResponse register_user(payload: RegisterRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates a new user and sets a refresh token cookie.

methods.name: TokenResponse login_user(payload: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and sets refresh token cookie.

methods.name: TokenResponse refresh_token(request: Request, response: Response)
methods.description: Uses refresh token from cookie to issue a new access token and rotate refresh token.

methods.name: Response logout_user(response: Response)
methods.description: Clears refresh token cookie to log out the user.

ctags.name: login_user
ctags.pattern: /^def login_user(payload: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep)) -> /
ctags.signature: (payload: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^def register_user(payload: RegisterRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep/
ctags.signature: (payload: RegisterRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
